verdict.reasons: The candidate image displays the physical carton packaging of the drip tape lying on the soil next to an installed lateral line, which functions as a visual substitute for the operating plumbing, violating the structural rule that packaging must not be used as hardware. Additionally, the Persian text on the packaging contains clear hallucinations and nonsensical character sequences, indicating a core defect in brand authenticity.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad, uninterrupted soil gap is visible around the complete footprint of the package on all sides, including behind it. The installed irrigation line runs parallel to the package but is physically separated by a clear section of soil and does not touch, emerge from, or disappear underneath the package base. Only the single required white-and-blue AFP package is present; there are no additional loose coils or rolls. The carton sides and base are clean with no visible protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tails.
